name: Zalmunna
bio: Zalmunna was a king of Midian who, together with fellow king Zebah, had killed Gideon's own brothers at Tabor. Gideon pursued the two kings across the Jordan with his three hundred exhausted men; when the men of Succoth and Penuel refused to supply food along the way, Gideon vowed to punish them on his return, and finally caught Zebah and Zalmunna by surprise at Karkor (Judges 8:4-12). Gideon asked the two kings what the men they had killed at Tabor looked like; they answered, "Men like you, each one with the bearing of a prince," and Gideon replied, "Those were my brothers, my mother's sons," before personally putting both kings to death and taking the ornaments from their camels' necks (Judges 8:18-21).
